bug_patterns.name: OTP bypass via loose comparison
bug_patterns.description: OTP/password checks using == instead of === allow type juggling bypass

bug_patterns.name: No auth check on destructive operation
bug_patterns.description: Functions like clear_database, db_backup without role/auth check

bug_patterns.name: trans_commit on failure branch
bug_patterns.description: trans_commit() called after error check — should be trans_rollback()

bug_patterns.name: trans_complete instead of begin/commit
bug_patterns.description: CI2 trans_complete() auto-commits regardless of errors — should use trans_begin/commit/rollback
